content:
As the 2026 World Cup approaches its conclusion, Major League Soccer (MLS) will return to Apple TV tomorrow, with multiple platforms including Apple Maps, Apple Sports, and Apple Fitness+ simultaneously rolling out a range of related features. Details are as follows.

MLS Returns to Apple TV

Apple is today specially highlighting the return of Apple League Soccer, with six matches scheduled over the coming days:

July 17 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs Toronto FC (7:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Chicago Fire vs Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • St. Louis City SC vs Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM Eastern Time)
  • Seattle Sounders vs Portland Timbers (10:30 PM Eastern Time)

July 18 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM Eastern Time)
  • LA Galaxy vs LAFC (10:15 PM Eastern Time)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple has announced a series of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a brand-new "Time to Walk" audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The latest episode features German football legend Thomas Müller, who "reflects on the efforts he made before becoming famous and shares why he embraces the challenges of major life transitions."

Apple Music will also launch a number of exclusive playlists personally curated by star players, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake and Evander Da Silva Fernandes of FC Cincinnati, as well as themed playlists from Eastern and Western Conference teams such as the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, and Orlando City SC.

On Apple Maps, Apple will launch "Matchday Guides" produced by MLS clubs, as well as city guides personally curated by players, helping fans discover restaurants near the stadium, local attractions, and providing detailed information about the venues.

Users of the Apple Sports app can keep up with the latest league developments, including live scores, standings, match play-by-play, lineups, and team statistics.

Apple concluded by saying:

MLS matches are available at no extra cost to Apple TV subscribers in over 100 countries and regions; Apple will also provide exclusive content, tournament, and playoff viewing access throughout the season.

For more coverage of Apple's coverage of the MLS return, please follow this link.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or as part of an Apple One bundle subscription. The platform offers a range of hit series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.
